_EXAMPLE_ONLY: Shape of one entry in backend/config/tags.json. The values below are the project's T-01 tag (Delta AH500 D11008, REAL, from our IO list) - mapping_verified is false: it has not been checked against the live PLC. Edit tags on the Settings > Tags page, not by hand.

tag.name: T-01 Dryer to Radiator Temp
tag.source_ref: Our IO list 16_03_2026 / Analog input row 4

_field_notes.device: Modbus mode only: Delta device address; the Modbus address is calculated (AH500 manual App. B.1) or overridden on the Tags page.
_field_notes.source_id: Gateway API mode only: the reading id in the gateway reply. Blank = plc_tag, then id.
_field_notes.alarm: Dashboard-calculated limits (labelled DASHBOARD on the Alarms page). PLC alarms come from PLC bits and are labelled PLC.
_field_notes.mapping_verified: Tick only after comparing the value with the HMI / ISPSoft monitor on site.
